description: This Python source file implements a WebRTC request handler class for managing peer connections, including handling SDP offers/answers, ICE candidates, and connection modes, with support for ESP32-specific SDP munging.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a WebRTC request with SDP, type, and optional peer connection ID and restart flag.

classes.name: IceCandidate
classes.description: Data class representing an ICE candidate with SDP candidate string, mid, and mline index.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCPatchRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a patch request with peer connection ID and list of ICE candidates.

classes.name: ConnectionMode
classes.description: Enum defining connection handling modes: SINGLE or MULTIPLE.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCRequestHandler
classes.description: Class managing WebRTC peer connections, handling requests, and connection modes, with support for SDP munging and ICE candidate management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the request handler with optional ICE servers, mode, host, and ESP32 mode.

methods.name: _check_single_connection_constraints
methods.description: Checks if a new connection request complies with single connection mode constraints.

methods.name: update_ice_servers
methods.description: Updates the list of ICE servers used for WebRTC connections.

methods.name: handle_web_request
methods.description: Processes an incoming WebRTC request, reusing or creating connections, invoking callbacks, and returning SDP answers.

methods.name: handle_patch_request
methods.description: Handles ICE candidate patch requests for a specific peer connection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all active peer connections and clears the connection map.
